text: Shut-in EB 599 SS001. Record SITP. Using ROV, dive to 599 SS001 subsea tree and function open the hydraulic supply needle valves. Close the lower sleeve (BS-60 zone) from the platform control panel. Bleed ~500 psi off the tubing to the flowline. Monitor SITP for 1 hr for signs of leaking sleeves. Open the upper sleeve from the platform control panel. Using ROV, function closed the hydraulic supply needle valves on subsea tree. Depart ROV. Open 599 SS001 BS-58 zone to production.

The EC 339 A01BP wellbore has been completed for production. The wellbore was spud on January 14, 2007 and drilled to TD on January 25, 2007 at a depth of 7892'MD / 7816' TVD.  The wellbore was TA'd on February 06, 2007.  The EC 339 A platform was installed over the TA wellbore stub and the well tied-back and completion for production. Completion operations of the well began on July 30, 2007 and were completed on August 11, 2007.  The well was completed as a single, GP, oil completion in the "Ang B 7200' Sd. with perforations of 7658' - 7750' MD.  The well is shut-in waiting on pipeline and facilities hook up. Expected start of production operations is scheduled for mid September 2007.

In April 2015, the well was discovered to be seeping oil droplets.  Well intervention operations were performed to bring the well conductors back to vertical position and install a temporary wellhead on the 9-5/8" casing. The well was then permanently plugged by installing regulatory approved mechanical and cement barriers to fully isolate the RE12FB44 Reservoir perforations from 12,056' - 12,102'.  Operations were divided into 5 phases and took place from 8/9/2015 to 11/19/2018.

The EI 302 w#04 well was spud on 04-23-10 and drilled to a total depth of 9950' MD / TVD on 04-24-10, w/a MW of 16.2 ppg.   7 5/8" prod. csg was set at TD and the well was then temporarily abandoned via a mud line suspension system.  TA operations were completed on 05-31-10 and the rig moved off location on 06-04-10.

Attempts to recover stuck tools with CT were unsuccessful. Well status has not changed. An APM was submitted & approved to pull tubing, replace tubing, SCSSV & production seals using Spartan 208 JU rig.

The GD005 well riserless section was drilled with the Transocean Deepwater Pontus. The rig will then suspend operations and move to the next well in the campaign. The Transcocean Pontus is scheduled to deepen the well in Q3 2020, which will be the subject of a separate permit.

Unable to pull plug stuck in nipple at 13,495' MD. Washed down to top of the plug with coil tubing and washed out sand and scale and then attempted to pull plug with coil tubing after previous attempts with slickline failed. Operations suspended after a CIBP was set at 13,485' MD. Did not change zones to IZ Sand. Operations took place 04/17/2017 - 05/20/2017.
